name: Go Fish
tagline: Ask for the cards you need and collect books of four. Great with kids.

options.label: Play until every book is made

rulesSummary: Five cards each (seven with two players); the rest make the pond.
On your turn, pick a card and ask another player for that rank. If they have any, they hand them all over and you ask again.
If not — “Go fish!” — draw from the pond. Drew the rank you asked for? Show it and go again. Otherwise the turn passes left.
Four of a kind is a book: it goes down at once. The game ends when someone runs out of cards or the pond runs dry, and the most books wins.
Option: play until every book is made — an empty hand draws five more, and once the pond is empty a wrong guess just passes the turn.
